text:
tara: Quick sync — we need to lock a firm timeline for v2 enforcement. Product wants ~2 weeks notice before v1 sunset. Who's owning migration comms + SDK bump?

simon: I can own comms + release notes. Need infra confirmation on the router cutover window first.

devon: infra dependency: the routing change requires the new compat shim on the proxy side (PR landed but not in prod). Targeting a maintenance window Friday 09:00-11:00 UTC. ops ok with that? @ops-bot any conflicts?

ops-bot: deploy-window-approved: 2025-08-08T09:00:00Z to 2025-08-08T11:00:00Z. Noted: capacity bump needed for canary.

zach: For canary we want 1% traffic -> 10% -> 100% over 48h with automatic rollback on 5xx spike or latency > 2x p50. Who owns the rollback playbook? :eyes:

maya: I'll own the rollback playbook + smoke scripts. I'll add the health checks to the canary playbook and run a rehearsal on Thursday.

simon: SDK bump plan: release redwood-sdk 2.1.0 with v2 as opt-in, then 2.2.0 with v2 default after the notice period. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 (needs reviews + changelog).

repo snippet (for the changelog):
```
Deprecation: v1 endpoints will be disabled 2025-08-22 UTC.
Migration: clients should upgrade to redwood-sdk >= 2.1.0 and set REDWOOD_API_VERSION=v2
```

zach: pinging @simon for reviews, @devon for infra rollout approval. I can drop a small test harness to simulate prefix cache hit/miss.

devon: approved from infra once the proxy shim is promoted to canary tomorrow at 16:00 UTC. Need owners list for customer outreach so support can triage pre-sunset spikes.

simon: I'll draft the customer notice and add the migration checklist. Draft link: https://docs.internal.redwood/migration/v2-draft (will share later).

tara: Owners summary for the announcement: comms = simon, rollback/qa = maya, infra cutover = devon, canary monitoring = zach, SDK release = simon. Is that accurate?

maya: yep. I'll add the rehearsal notes and the runbook link to simon's draft.

simon: tagging reviewers: @tara please sanity-check dates; @zach please add the Canary metrics and alert thresholds to the PR.

tara: Dates look good. One ask: make sure the SDK migration guide has code snippets for both sync and streaming clients.

simon: will do. Quick reminder for the SDK team: example bump command:
```
# for pip
pip install redwood-sdk==2.1.0
# env flag to opt-in
export REDWOOD_API_VERSION=v2
```

zach: I'll post the perf baseline numbers after the rehearsal, then we can firm the 48h promotion cadence.

ops-bot: note: incident channel #incidents will be notified automatically if rollback triggers.

tara: Thanks everyone — next checkpoint async: I'll check for PR + draft by EOD tomorrow. If someone needs a brief sync, drop a :calendar: and I'll schedule 15m.

simon: :thumbsup: I'll mark the comms draft ready and assign reviews.

maya: rehearsals Thursday 15:30-16:30 UTC; invite sent.

zach: added smoke harness and PR to infra repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987 — requesting @devon review.

devon: reviewing now, will approve if the health-check backoff is handled.

simon: final ask — any customers pinned to v1 (explicit tenant flag)? please drop names here so support can pre-notify.

maya: adding list to the draft now.

End of thread.
